title: Interstellar
synopsis: A dying Earth, a wormhole, a daughter you leave behind, and a love that turns out to be a coordinate.

nodes.text: A harvest is failing and a bookshelf is dropping books in patterns.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Investigate” back. Curious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Brush it off” back. Practical shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Murph's pattern points to a base nobody knew existed.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cautious.

nodes.text: Brand offers a seat on a mission to find humanity a home.

choices.consequence: “Take it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Father.

nodes.text: Murph throws a watch and screams from a doorway.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Mercy—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Brand is alone on Edmunds' planet and nobody else is coming.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Go.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Stay.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You land beside a small camp at the edge of a quiet sea. Brand walks out of the airlock with the dirt of a new world on her boots.
You sit with Murph until she sleeps and you hold her grandchild on your knee and you do not get up for a long time.
You take a janitor's job on Cooper Station and look up at the slow rotation of the wheel at night and you call yourself, finally, retired.
